name: Ilberg

attributes.attribute: an Irish god, son of Manannán Mac Lir, candidate to lead the Tuatha Dé Danann
retired to his palace at the magical waterfall of Assaroe after defeat

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ilberg is an Irish god. The god of fertility, the Dagda, decided to give up his leadership of the Tuatha Dé Danann. Ilberg was then a candidate for the office. Ilberg is the son of the sea god Manannán Mac Lir. Ilberg did not win the office. He then retired to his palace at the magical waterfall of Assaroe.

okr.objective: Document the Irish god Ilberg and his candidacy to lead the Tuatha Dé Danann.
key_results: Record his father Manannán Mac Lir.
Record his candidacy after the Dagda gave up leadership.
